category: Svelte 5 virtual chat viewport — windowed message list purpose-built for LLM/support chat: follow-bottom, streaming-stable, history-prepend with anchor preservation

repo_triage._comment: Public repo — GITHUB_TOKEN raises rate limits; public-read fallback works without it. Surfaces open PRs/issues NOT opened by github_handle, and threads awaiting your reply since the previous last_run.

self_features: Virtualized message viewport (renders only visible messages) for long chat histories
Follow-bottom that survives streaming — stays pinned while tokens arrive, releases on user scroll-up
History-prepend with scroll-anchor preservation (load older messages without a jump)
Streaming-stable measurement for variable-height, growing messages
Svelte 5 runes; purpose-built for LLM conversations, support chat, any message-based UI
non_goals: A general-purpose table/grid virtualizer — this is message-shaped (sibling @humanspeak/svelte-virtual-list covers generic lists)
A chat UI kit / bubbles / markdown rendering — it's the viewport, not the message components

competitors.note: Popular Svelte virtual list; generic windowing, not chat-aware (no follow-bottom / prepend-anchor / streaming stability)
Framework-spanning headless virtualizer with a Svelte adapter; powerful but you build the chat behaviors yourself

watchlist.note: The original Svelte virtual list; largely dormant/Svelte-3 era — watch for any revival
